newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SPT says sees higher 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Czech SPT says sees higher 1996 profit.

text.p: Czech telephone operator SPT Telecom a.s. on Thursday said it expected to post higher profits, calculated according to international accounting standards (IAS), in 1996.
SPT Fianncial Director Urs Kamber said the firm would post a higher profit, but refused to give an exact forecast. Last year, SPT posted an IAS net profit of 4.829 billion crowns.

"According to the development of the third quarter, one can count on the profitability of the company at the end of the year," he said. "Profits should be higher that they were in 1995, even after write-offs."
Depreciation for the entire year should be "about six billion crowns" Kambers said. In 1995, SPT's write-offs totalled 4.67 billion crowns.
A consortium of Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV and Swiss Telecom bought a 27 percent stake in SPT last year from the Czech government for $1.32 billion plus $141 million in additional services.
